summary: Apogee Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement with a subsidiary of AbbVie Inc. Under the terms, AbbVie will acquire all outstanding shares of Apogee for $135.11 per share in cash. The per-share consideration represents a premium to the unaffected price. The board recommends shareholders vote in favor. The merger is structured as a tender offer followed by a second-step merger, with Apogee surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. Shareholders who do not vote in favor may seek appraisal rights. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals and stockholder vote. Watch for the tender offer commencement and regulatory review timeline.
